name: Pin-Crawl
description:
About This Game

Pin-Crawl is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler with a pinball twist! Play as Morgan the witch and her round, slimy pal Smush, on a quest to defeat the evil sorceress and rescue your village friends who have been put under her spell.

  • Bop, bounce and bash your way through a dungeon full of weird and wacky enemies.
  • Cast Morgan's magic using her enchanted flippers.
  • Zip around the table using Smush's Dash power.
  • Power up your abilities with treasure and rewards collected on your journey.
  • Handcrafted pinball tables with beautiful pixel art.

Powers

Slow down time, aim and Dash to perform precision shots. Hit enemies and tricky to reach features on the table and manipulate the ball to your advantage.

Cast Magic Shot towards the ball with your flippers, hitting anything in it's path. Enemies and table features can trap the ball, giving you an opportunity to target them with Magic Shot directly.

Spells and Rune Stones

Learn spells to give you a unique advantage against the dungeons inhabitants. Charge up and cast them by hitting their coresponding feature on the table. Cast Freeze by hitting ramps! Cast Regenerate Health by hitting Pop-Bumpers! Launch and extra ball by hitting enemies, and many more!

Collect Rune Stones to power up Dash and Magic Shot; enhance your health, attack, and defense stats; super charge extra balls; and increase your chances of grabbing rare loot.

Creepy Crawling

Outwit the menacing monsters who are trying to stop you in your tracks. Bonk, bash, zip and zap your way through a menagerie increasingly challenging beasties. Do you have the skills to defeat them all and face the Sorceress in the final showdown!?
short_desc: Pin-Crawl is a dungeon crawling pinball rogue-lite! Bop, bash and dash your way through a dungeon of weird and wacky foes as you collect abilities and upgrades on your way to defeating the Evil Sorceress!
